entities.summary: John Abdulai Jinapor is a Ghanaian politician, a Member of Parliament representing the Yapei-Kusawgu constituency and Minister in charge of the Ministry of Energy and Petroleum (Ghana). He is a former Minister of State of Ghana. He is a member of the National Democratic Congress.
